meta.name: answer-ads-questions
meta.description: Answer questions about a brand's Meta ads (spend, results, which ad is winning, is it paused, why did Goose do that) only from reads made in the same turn, with the data window and sync time on every number and a plain caveat when the connection is stale or partial. Use it whenever a user asks how their ads are doing or why an ad action was taken.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 问清广告花了多少、哪条在赢、为什么被暂停
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每天都想看广告表现,又不确定数据是不是最新的。
copy.tagline_en: Ask how your Meta ads are doing, with every number dated and sourced
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run Meta ads and want trustworthy answers on spend and results

howto.what: 回答品牌 Meta 广告的表现问题时,只采用本轮实际读取的数据,每个数字都注明覆盖时段和同步时间;数据不全、过期或未连接时会直白说明,并且只读不改动任何广告。
howto.when: 当你问广告花得怎么样、某条广告是否暂停,或某次改动是为什么时触发。它会按 GooseWorks 工具、直连 Meta、仅规划三种模式中可用的第一种进入。

say.text: 我这几天的广告花得怎么样?
say.note: 会给出花费、覆盖日期和同步时间
会读完所有分页再排名

say.text: 你上次为什么暂停那条广告?
say.note: 会引用 decisions.md 的记录和证据指针

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude answers Meta ads questions only from reads made in the same turn. Every number carries its date window and sync time, and stale, partial or disconnected data is stated plainly. Read-only: it changes nothing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask how the ads are doing, whether an ad is paused, or why a change was made. It uses the first available of three modes: GooseWorks tools, direct Meta, or planning only.

say_en.text: How did my ads do these past days?
say_en.note: Gives spend with window and sync time.

say_en.text: Why did you pause that ad?
say_en.note: Quotes the decisions.md entry and evidence.
